quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaching, you must:

options.text: Keep your speed and stay in your lane until the vehicle passes.
Move to the right lane and drive slowly until the vehicle passes.
Pull over to the edge of the road and stop until the vehicle passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the edge of the road and stop until the vehicle passes.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, pull over to the right edge of the road and stop. Stay parallel to the curb. On one-way streets, move toward the nearest road edge.

questions.question: When changing lanes:

options.text: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to make sure the lane is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to make sure the lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your side mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure it is safe to move.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully and slowly on slippery roads.

questions.question: Driving while taking medication that affects your driving is permitted:
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive while taking anything that affects your ability to drive safely. This includes alcohol, prescription drugs, over-the-counter medicines, and illegal drugs.

questions.question: At an intersection with a flashing yellow light, you must:

options.text: Wait for the green light before going.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, pay attention, and proceed carefully. Watch for traffic crossing your path and pedestrians.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol socially, what helps ensure safe driving?

options.text: Get a ride home from a friend who has not been drinking.
Take a cold shower before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get a ride home from a friend who has not been drinking.
questions.explanation: The best way to avoid driving while impaired is to arrange a ride home with someone who is not drinking. Coffee and cold showers do not reduce alcohol in your system. It takes about one hour for your body to process one drink.

questions.question: You notice a vehicle defect that may affect safe driving. You should:

options.text: Fix the defect as soon as possible.
Fix the defect when you have money.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fix the defect as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Any defect that may affect safe driving should be fixed as soon as possible. Do not drive the vehicle until it is repaired.

questions.question: When approaching an intersection with a flashing yellow light, you must:
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means be alert and proceed with caution. Slow down when you see this signal.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see a:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, look both ways, and go only when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other vehicles?

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
Get to the front of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash your lights and honk to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Each time you pass another vehicle, the risk of collision increases. If you drive faster than traffic around you, you will need to keep passing. Drive with traffic flow at the legal speed limit and pass only when necessary.

questions.question: You do not have to stop for a school bus with red lights flashing if it is on a private road.
questions.explanation: You must stop for a school bus with red lights flashing and its stop arm out. This rule applies on both public and private roads.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines between traffic lanes mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from the left.
Passing is allowed from the right.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Double solid lines mean no passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.question: Why is it important to keep space between your vehicle and others?

options.text: It prevents distractions from other vehicles.
It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
It keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
questions.explanation: Leaving space between you and other vehicles gives you time to react if other drivers make mistakes.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use high beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect back at you and make it harder to see.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line down the center of a road mean?

options.text: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means drivers can pass when there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does a red arrow pointing right on a traffic light mean?

options.text: Turn in that direction after slowing and checking for traffic.
Do not turn in that direction until the light turns green.
Turn in that direction after coming to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not turn in that direction until the light turns green.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means stop. You must wait until a green light or green arrow appears before turning.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Sharp left and right turns ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a winding road is coming. Slow down as needed.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, or in rain or snow, how can you let other drivers know you are there?
questions.explanation: Use your headlights whenever it is hard to see or be seen. Use low beam headlights when weather requires you to use your windshield wipers.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: Is speeding the best way to avoid losing control on wet roads?
questions.explanation: On wet roads, your tires can ride on water and cause you to lose control. This is called hydroplaning. Slow down when driving on wet roads to avoid this.

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Stop completely, check for traffic, then go when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, check for traffic, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop, just like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop. Yield to other cars and pedestrians. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line in the center of a road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean you cannot pass.

questions.question: When turning left, who do you have to yield to?
questions.explanation: When turning left, yield to oncoming traffic going straight. Only turn when it is safe and will not affect oncoming cars.

questions.question: You are in an accident and someone is injured. What should you do?

options.text: Move the injured person right away.
Always leave the injured person where they are.
Do not move them unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
Stay away from the injured person.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not move them unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
questions.explanation: Do not move injured people unless you must. Moving them the wrong way can make injuries worse. Keep them warm. If there is heavy bleeding, apply direct pressure to stop it.

questions.question: When can you park on the shoulder of a freeway?

options.text: Whenever you turn on your emergency flashers.
If no part of your car is on the road.
If you need to check a map.

questions.explanation: You cannot park on a freeway shoulder except in an emergency.

questions.question: At night, what is hardest to see while driving?
questions.explanation: Pedestrians are much harder to see at night than road signs and other objects.

questions.question: You are stopped at a red light with a green arrow. When can you go in the direction of the arrow?

options.text: After you come to a complete stop.
After you wait for the light to change.
If you are in the right lane and the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are in the right lane and the intersection is clear.
questions.explanation: You can go in the direction of a green arrow if you are in the correct lane and the intersection is clear. Yield to pedestrians and vehicles already in the intersection.

questions.question: What comes after a steady yellow traffic light?
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: How can you help prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots for traffic before stopping.
Release the gas pedal to slow down before applying the brakes.

questions.explanation: Sudden stops make it hard for drivers behind you to stop in time. Release the gas pedal to let your car slow down. Then apply steady brake pressure. This gives drivers behind you time to react.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are yellow and warn drivers about hazards or special driving rules ahead. Orange diamond signs are used in work areas.

questions.question: Motorcycles are hard to see. What should you do?

options.text: Share a lane with a motorcycle.

questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and can hide in your blind spot. Always watch carefully for motorcycles, mopeds, and scooters.

questions.question: How can you prevent crashes caused by drinking and driving?

options.text: Decide before drinking that you will not drive.
Tell people "No thanks, I'm driving" when they offer you a drink.

questions.explanation: The best way to avoid drunk driving crashes is to decide before drinking that you will not drive. Alcohol affects your judgment, making it hard to make safe choices once you start drinking.

questions.question: What does this speed limit sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this speed through intersections.
The highest safe speed under good conditions is 55 mph.
You cannot drive slower than this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed under good conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs tell you the maximum legal speed. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: When should you not use your horn?

options.text: When you cannot see far ahead.
If you might hit another vehicle.

questions.explanation: Do not use your horn near blind pedestrians. It may scare them. Yield to them and drive on when it is safe.
